plan.title: Block Rejecting a Live RFQ Bid

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with a vendor bid already submitted.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the RFQ scenario.
Keep counter offers visible on RFQ responses as required by the case.
Enable the setting that should block bid rejection while bidding is open.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the scenario configuration.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the scenario configuration.
Attempt to reject the submitted bid and require positive evidence that Procol blocks the action during live bidding.
